The Data Skills Portfolio (DSP) Program is based at Aarhus University’s Department of Biology.
The DSP Program is designed to help you develop robust and useful quantitative skills for biological research and many fields beyond.
Here you will find a description of the program along with DSP handbook materials.
Explore and enjoy!
And remember: your feedback is welcome!
